content.content:
Fred,

I'm in LA from tomorrow for Dentsu and the Griffin AGM, so can you take over the vendor and partner backlog this week? That's anyone outside the investor work who has an offer, a trial, a quote, terms or an ask in front of us and that one of us has actually engaged with: a call, a reply, a sign-up or paper. Cold pitches nobody answered, including ones we only forwarded around internally, stay off it, and so do the ad networks, PlayableX, Craftsman+ and Singular (they all stay on the UA budget call), the investors, and Mattel, which I'm keeping.

Go by the runway guardrails doc for what we do with each one, plus the one change I posted in #executives on Monday. Anything that needs signing goes the way ESG's note about signing says.

Everyone who is waiting to hear from us should get a written answer this week. Get each company's contact into Contacts so we're not digging through mail next time.

Log it all in a sheet in the Q4 commitments folder, the README in the folder has the columns. Then reply here with what we're keeping and what's waiting on Arthur or me to sign.

Thanks,
Leonard

{"documentId": "f_b98287f6f80fe431a71209", "title": "Runway guardrails - Q4 commitments", "name": "Runway guardrails - Q4 commitments", "revisionId": "0d3b4ff7c7", "createdTime": "2025-09-26T16:00:00Z", "modifiedTime": "2025-09-26T18:00:00Z", "text": "Runway guardrails - Q4 commitments
Leonard, Sep 26. Until we know where the raise lands, this is how we handle anything outside the investor work that wants money, a signature or an answer from us.
How to decide
Go top to bottom and stop at the first one that fits.
1. Already answered. If one of us has already given them an answer, don't write to them again. Note who answered and when. If the answer was "later", it comes back at the January commitments review I'll put on our calendars too.
2. Cash test. Anything that would cost us cash between Oct 1 and Dec 31 ends now: say no, or cancel it in writing the way their paper or notice asks. A trial or pilot that turns into a paid plan inside that window counts as cash, and so does an offer we would have to take up and pay for before January. Travel and event costs count only when we book them ourselves.
3. Keep. The cash test has one exception: anything on Arthur's keep-running list on our board stays, even if it costs money. Tell them we're staying.
4. Sign. If it costs nothing before January but taking it means someone has to accept terms or sign for the company, it goes the way ESG's note says. Tell them it's with Leonard or Arthur to sign, and with our lawyers first when ESG has to see it.
5. Park. Everything else that's free until January, including offers we could still take up after that. Tell them we'll pick it up in January; it comes back at the January commitments review I'll put on our calendars (first week of January).
Answers
Everyone who is waiting to hear from us gets a written answer. Portals and no-reply notices don't need one.
"}

I forwarded it to you guys but copy-pasting just in case. TLDR, we needed metrics and engine is only valuable if you can make hits.

Leonard and team,

Thanks again for walking us through harmonygames. We really appreciated the transparency around where the team is today, and the clarity of your long-term vision. It’s obvious this isn’t your first rodeo and we were impressed by how well you’ve scoped the infrastructure, the operating cadence, and the product roadmap.

After reviewing internally and discussing as a team, we’ve made the difficult decision not to include Harmony Games in the upcoming speedrun cohort. In the spirit of transparency and in the hope that it’s helpful, I wanted to pass along a synthesis of our feedback:

There’s a lot to like about what you’re building:
• You’ve assembled a serious team. The collective experience across [USERNAME_41301], Zynga, Wildlife, LucasArts, and others gives you an operational fluency that most early teams just don’t have. The fact that so many of you have worked together over 10+ years also came through as There’s a clear rhythm to how you’re executing.
• We liked the conviction behind the genre focus. Betting on puzzle RPGs with a repeatable infrastructure layer is smart, especially in such a hit-driven category where multiple shots on goal are often required. The fact that you shipped your second title in 4 months (vs. 18 months for the first) is a great sign that your internal systems are working and that you’re building toward true scalability.
• There’s early signal in the new build. Day 0 playtime in the 20+ minute range, and 2–3 hour sessions among your top decile players, are meaningful signals! t’s clear you’re iterating quickly, and that the new design layers (RPG progression, PvE boss fights, PvP events) are pushing you in the right direction.
What’s holding us back at this stage is primarily around timing and financial flexibility. We understand the need to move fast, but with ~4 months of runway remaining and the seed extension still in progress, it feels a little early for us to step in. We’d want to see the new game stabilize around key metrics (particularly Day 1 and Day 7 retention) before jumping in at this stage. The early improvements are promising but still not at a place where we can underwrite that the bridge will get you to a place where you can raise the next round.

We also debated the durability of the long-term differentiation. While your internal OS is clearly speeding up dev cycles, it’s still early to tell whether this becomes a repeatable machine that can consistently spin out hits, or if the value will still come down to nailing individual titles. We’d love to see a few more launches and how the stack evolves as the system matures.


This was a tough call. You’re clearly a seasoned, high-integrity team operating with speed and discipline. We’ll be cheering for you as the new game gets into the market, and we’d love to reconnect once retention and engagement metrics stabilize.

Thanks again for sharing the journey with us. Wishing you continued momentum, and we’d be excited to revisit speedrun if it makes sense in a future cohort.

Best,

Dana Whitfield

Hana

Hi Frederick,

Thanks for the call on Tuesday. As promised, the order form for Pro is attached: 4 seats, unlimited template and stock-clip downloads. Pro starts Nov 1 at $149/month, billed monthly, and you keep the free seat until then.

Can you let me know by mid-October if we should set it up?

Best,
Maren
----
Hi Frederick,

Thanks for the call on Wednesday. We'd like to feature Zombie Match 3D in our November puzzle week. The featuring agreement has to be accepted in our partner portal by an authorised signatory of the company. No fees. Could that happen by Oct 24?

Mateo
----
Hi Frederick,

Great chatting. Proposal attached for a pre-registration push at the Seattle Indie Expo on Nov 7: we cover the stand and two passes, you cover travel for two. We'll book the flights and hotel and invoice you at cost.

Sven
----
Hi Frederick,

Thanks for the chat. I've sent our deck for the holiday puzzle bundle: no cost to join, and it includes a licence to use Domino Delights' name and art in the bundle marketing. Submissions close Nov 1.

Freya
----

Spotlight issue is the only blocker, aside from the hard crash.\", \"channel\": \"C08R27X0EAH\", \"user\": \"EMPLOYEE_0016_SLACK_ID\"}, {\"ts\": \"1747071349.080009\", \"type\": \"message\", \"text\": \"More spotlight issues \", \"channel\": \"C05V5FNLB9V\", \"user\": \"EMPLOYEE_0008_SLACK_ID\", \"thread_ts\": \"1747071349.080009\"}, {\"ts\": \"1747070685.967899\", \"type\": \"message\", \"text\": \"Spotlight issue\", \"channel\": \"C08R27X0EAH\", \"user\": \"EMPLOYEE_0008_SLACK_ID\", \"thread_ts\": \"1747070168.513299\"}, {\"ts\": \"1747070654.576079\", \"type\": \"message\", \"text\": \"Another spotlight issue.\", \"channel\": \"C08R27X0EAH\", \"user\": \"EMPLOYEE_0008_SLACK_ID\"}, {\"ts\": \"1729800703.265689\", \"type\": \"message\", \"text\": \"TL:DR any time we dim, it creates a risk of something breaking and players can no longer click to progress because whatever spotlight they are allowed to click on is actually not interactable. This is probably why we  have all these concentration of key dimming events where they are the last event by a user prior to churning. By having a fail safe and allowing the players to click through via click anywhere on screen after X seconds, we can reduce the risk of this, but at the expensive of someone possibly fast tapping through an important FTUE message.\", \"channel\": \"C05H8KVNU67\", \"user\": \"EMPLOYEE_0016_SLACK_ID\", \"thread_ts\": \"1729800703.265689\"}, {\"ts\": \"1729800493.226679\", \"type\": \"message\", \"text\": \"This is the deep dive report thus far for first 3 levels:\\n\\u2022 We do not see any app exceptions, they are all gone from first 3 levels.\\n\\u2022 We did have some forced restarts, but only among people that started level 1, and did not finish level 1, and I believe a handful were company internal installs based out of Seattle ([PERSON_NAME_0036])\\n\\u2022 We have noticed that There are restarts not captured by the \\\"forced_kill_app\\\" event, but instead we derived that There was a restart from a \\\"user_session\\\" and \\\"play_login\\\" event at strange times after the initial app launch. Also the fact that There are tutorial events prefixed with \\\"bookmarked_xxx\\\" which is only something that can trigger if someone have left the app (quit)\\n\\u2022 So far out of 6 players observed that's not US installs for started level 1 but not finished level 1, at least 2 of them had some indicator of restarts, or having really abrupt last event. In a normal healthy quitting funnel, the last event is typically \\\"user_engagement\\\" (This is the event that Firebase use to measure session time). Any time the player does not have user_engagement as their last event, it's quite suspicious.\\n\\u2022 For people that started level 2 but did not finish level 2 (3 observed). 2 of them had bookmarked tutorial events, meaning they restarted their app.\\n\\u2022 For people that started level 3 but did not finish level 3 (11 observed), 2 are definitely suspicious and involving some restarts, the others all concentrated on this single step where we dim and spotlight the gold tile boost, but for some reason these people don't go beyond that step, it's almost as if the dimming/spotlight drove them away. This is highly suspicious still.\\nAction items:\\n\\u2022 We have noticed that the FTUE can put you in a permanent stasis, albeit quite difficult. If you manage to get to the character tutorial, you upgrade sophie for the first time using your token (deducted from inventory), but you didn't finish that entire character tutorial (quit before the \\\"let's go back and see what sophie can do now\\\"), upon restart, your FTUE will error out and dim in a place unclickable, and it will happen doesn't matter how many restarts you have, you will be 100% stuck, forever. As a result of this, <@EMPLOYEE_0005_SLACK_ID> will be making most of the tutorial steps to be able to be clicked away, after a ~1 second pause. This is so that in the event where a dimming is done improperly in an unclickable part of the game, the click anywhere should at least give the players a chance to progress.\\n\\u2022 We are also fixing the bookedmarked version of the tutorial. What this means is that currently if you were in level 2 wildcard tutorial, and you quit before you finish the level, on the restart, playing the same exact level will now trigger sophie's streak ability of +1 card, where as on the non bookmarked version of the tutorial, that ability is purposely disabled. Players can get stuck like this if they end up drawing the card sophie granted them, and if it's not a match, the game ends up in a loss.\\n\\u2022 Basically anytime you consume something because the FTUE makes you do it, the gold/item is permanently deducted from the inventory. And if you manage to restart the app before fully completing that portion of the tutorial, the restarted tutorial will ask you to conduct the same action again, but it can potentially cause an error because you no longer have the gold/item to pay for that action. These are edge cases but they are getting fixed.\", \"channel\": \"C05H8KVNU67\", \"user\": \"EMPLOYEE_0016_SLACK_ID\"}, {\"ts\": \"1727746925.264659\", \"type\": \"message\", \"text\": \"We should add a spotlight to the token on top right here\", \"channel\": \"C05H8KVNU67\", \"user\": \"EMPLOYEE_0016_SLACK_ID\", \"thread_ts\": \"1727746925.264659\"}, {\"ts\": \"1727142568.720329\", \"type\": \"message\", \"text\": \"<@EMPLOYEE_0005_SLACK_ID>\\n1. Level starts, highlight the chest, text \\\"Oh! What do we have here? A treasure chest! It looks like I need 4 keys to unlock this chest.\\\"\\n2. Highlight a key symbol, but don't allow player to click on it, dialog says \\\"Reveal 4 key symbols on the board _at the same time (special colored text)_ to open the chest\\\"\\n3. Highlight 2 different tiles both with 1 key symbol it each (this includes the previous highlighted tile, so essentially we're just adding another highlighted tile into the spotlight), dialog says \\\"It seems like we already have 2 keys, we just need to find 2 more.\\\"\\n4. Highlight a matchable tile on board, dialog says \\\"Hmm, let's try matching this one\\\" (This highlighted tile is the parent of at least 2 children tiles, and 2 children will have 1 key symbol each on them, this entire level is hardcoded, obviously)\\n5. Chest opens, treasure bounces out, dialogue says \\\"Great job! Remember it takes _four keys_ revealed _at the same time_ to open the chest. The number counter on the chest will help you keep track.\\\" (We should design the level in such a way that the loot will be in certain position on the board by purposely providing an empty landing spot, and the dialog does not cover the treasure)\\nFeel free to change it however you see fit.\", \"channel\": \"C05H8KVNU67\", \"user\": \"EMPLOYEE_0016_SLACK_ID\", \"thread_ts\": \"1727142568.720329\"}, {\"ts\": \"1722591627.603739\", \"type\": \"message\", \"text\": \"Maybe we can lower the number of objects around the corners, so There will be more space for spotlight\", \"channel\": \"C04V7N09LE7\", \"user\": \"EMPLOYEE_0009_SLACK_ID\", \"thread_ts\": \"1722590643.240309\"}, {\"ts\": \"1722591368.756369\", \"type\": \"message\", \"text\": \"but in the end i think the spotlight needed to be added in the level editor right?\", \"channel\": \"C04V7N09LE7\", \"user\": \"EMPLOYEE_0002_SLACK_ID\", \"thread_ts\": \"1722590643.240309\"}, {\"ts\": \"1721231048.981469\", \"type\": \"message\", \"text\": \"If There was tutorial I'm certain the hero token would have been matched before the spotlight drops\", \"channel\": \"C05H8KVNU67\", \"user\": \"EMPLOYEE_0016_SLACK_ID\", \"thread_ts\": \"1721192014.856009\"}], \"has_more\": true, \"total_count\": 37, \"response_metadata\": {\"next_cursor\": \"c2VhcmNoOm09MTcyMTIzMTA0OC45ODE0NjklN0NhNTUyMTJlY2MzOGJkOTc4N2ViMzI0YzdjYjRlNzlhNjtkPWQ7cz1hbGw=\"}}"}

Frederick Stone
Harmony Games

input.subject: Agreement review: Kinetic Arcade - publishing LOI for Zombie Match 3D (Japan/Korea)
input.body:
Hi ESG team,

Please open a matter for this agreement (one email per agreement, per your Sep 24 note).

- Company and agreement: Kinetic Arcade (contact Noor Haddad). Letter of intent to publish Zombie Match 3D in Japan and Korea on a revenue share.
- Term and automatic renewal: 12-month exclusivity period while they prepare the launch; no automatic renewal mentioned in their cover email.
- Exclusivity / licence of our IP: Yes - 12 months' exclusivity for Japan and Korea; publishing implies use of the Zombie Match 3D game and brand in those markets.
- Cost to us: None (revenue share, no cost to Harmony Games).
- Date they need it by: Oct 20, 2025 (signed).
- Who would sign: Leonard Hayes.

Noor's email with the LOI attached is in Frederick's inbox and can be forwarded on request.

Thanks,
Frederick Stone
Harmony Games

Hi ESG team,

Please open a matter for this agreement (one email per agreement, per your Sep 24 note).

- Company and agreement: Bundlehouse (contact Freya Olsen). Participation agreement for their holiday puzzle bundle featuring Domino Delights.
- Term and automatic renewal: Not stated in their emails (holiday bundle).
- Exclusivity / licence of our IP: Yes - includes a licence to use Domino Delights' name and art in the bundle marketing.
- Cost to us: None (no cost to join).
- Date they need it by: Nov 1, 2025 (submissions close; agreement needs signing by then).
- Who would sign: Leonard Hayes.

Freya's emails and deck are in Frederick's inbox and can be forwarded on request.

Thanks,
Frederick Stone
Harmony Games

Leonard,

Done. Everyone who was waiting has a written answer, each company's contact is in Contacts, and the full log is in the Q4 commitments folder ("Q4 commitments log", one row per company, columns from the README): https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/c52f220e850d6979/edit

What we're keeping (Arthur's keep-running list):
- Vaultline: nightly DB backups move to Standard, $19/month from the Oct 12 renewal
- Certwell: API domain SSL cert, $89/year, renews before Oct 20
- Pingwise (the night pager): moves to Team, $29/month from Nov 1

Waiting on you to sign:
- Kinetic Arcade: Japan/Korea publishing LOI for Zombie Match 3D (12 months' exclusivity). With ESG first; needs signing by Oct 20
- Bundlehouse: holiday bundle participation agreement (licenses Domino Delights' name and art). With ESG first; needed by Nov 1
- Orbit Store: November featuring agreement, no fees, accepted in their partner portal by Oct 24

Waiting on Arthur to sign:
- Lumencloud: Startup Program agreement for $25k credits (36-month term). With ESG first; cohort closes Oct 31
- Playfuse: mutual NDA on our template, before their Oct 8 call (no ESG review needed)
- Markward: free-tier click-through terms in their dashboard (no deadline; they're holding the setup)

I sent each of the three ESG ones to ESG Law intake as its own email, using your checklist. All six have cards in the To Do list on the Harmony Games board, with the company name in the card title.

The rest, in short:
- Ended (would cost cash before January), and each one told no: Brightlane, ASO retainer, Clipforge, localization quote, player panel, Bay Area Indie Showcase booth, Framewell Pro, trailer music licence, Seattle Indie Expo, November creator campaign, Spotlight Fest
  - Clipforge's pilot would have turned into $1,800/month on Oct 16. I cancelled it in writing to billing@paylane.io, as their notice asks.
  - Seattle Indie Expo counts as cash because of your Monday change: they would book our travel and bill us for it.
- Parked until the Jan 5 review: Lanternfly, Cloudlark, Pressbeam, Echohall, Hootline, Retainly, Quillcraft, Loopnote, Reviewly, Tilecast, Benchmarkly, the font licence and the voice-over quote. Each one has a reminder on my calendar for Jan 5.
- Already answered: Motive Forge. Arthur passed on Sep 19, so I didn't write to them again.
- Left off the log: Nova Rewards, because they withdrew their offer on Sep 23.

Thanks,
Fred

I've worked through the whole vendor and partner backlog using Leonard's rules: his runway guardrails doc, his #executives change from Monday, and ESG's note about signing. I've replied to Leonard on his email with what we're keeping and what's waiting on him or Arthur to sign. There are 34 companies on the log.

**Keep** (on Arthur's keep-running list; I told each one we're staying):
- Vaultline backups: $19/month from Oct 12.
- Certwell SSL certificate: $89/year, renews before Oct 20.
- Pingwise night pager: $29/month from Nov 1.

**Sign** (each vendor told who has it; a card for each is in the To Do list on the Harmony Games board):

| Company | Signer | Goes to ESG first? | Needed by |
|---|---|---|---|
| Kinetic Arcade | Leonard | Yes (12-month exclusivity) | Oct 20 |
| Bundlehouse | Leonard | Yes (licenses Domino Delights' name and art) | Nov 1 |
| Orbit Store (portal acceptance) | Leonard | No | Oct 24 |
| Lumencloud | Arthur | Yes (36-month term) | Oct 31 |
| Playfuse (mutual NDA on our template) | Arthur | No | Before Oct 8 |
| Markward (accept terms in their dashboard) | Arthur | No | No deadline |

I sent each of the three ESG agreements to ESG's intake address as its own email, using Leonard's checklist. I picked the signers myself, so swap them on the cards if you'd rather. Leonard is in LA, so the time-sensitive Playfuse NDA is on Arthur.

**End** (would cost cash before January; each one told no): Brightlane, the ASO retainer, Clipforge, the localization quote, the player panel, the Bay Area Indie Showcase booth, Framewell Pro, the trailer music licence, Seattle Indie Expo, the November creator campaign and Spotlight Fest.
- **Clipforge:** the pilot would have turned into $1,800/month on Oct 16. I also sent the written cancellation to billing@paylane.io, the way their notice asks. They haven't confirmed yet, so watch for that before Oct 15.
- **Seattle Indie Expo:** this only counts as cash because of Leonard's Monday change. They'd book our travel and bill us.

**Park** (each told we'll pick it up in January): Lanternfly, Cloudlark, Pressbeam, Echohall, Hootline, Retainly, Quillcraft, Loopnote, Reviewly, Tilecast, Benchmarkly, the font licence and the voice-over quote. The January review is Leonard's "Q4 commitments review" on Jan 5, and each of these has its own all-day reminder on your calendar that day.
- **Reviewly:** their 30-day trial ends around Oct 19 and they never said whether it turns paid. I parked it, but if a bill shows up it should be cancelled.

**Not written to:**
- **Motive Forge:** Arthur already passed on Sep 19, so it's logged as Answered.
- **Nova Rewards:** left off the log because they withdrew their offer.

The log is "Q4 commitments log" in your Q4 commitments folder, shared with Leonard: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/c52f220e850d6979/edit

I added 31 contacts with the company in the job field; Leah Brennan, Aiden Clarke and Noor Haddad were already there. A few vendors never named their company in their emails, so their log rows and contacts use a description instead, such as "Font licence (Tomas Novotny)".
